title: Zesty Jammy French Pastry Mille Feuille
description: A dairy-free friendly French pastry featuring strong wholemeal flour and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a weeknight dessert. This jammy and gooey mille-feuille is a twist on the classic French dessert.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine wholemeal flour, all purpose flour, and salt.
In a separate bowl, combine non-dairy milk, non-dairy butter, and sugar, and mix until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough ferment for 2 hours in a warm place.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the dough to a large rectangle and spread the jam evenly over the center of the dough.
Fold the dough into a mille-feuille shape and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Let the pastry cool for 10 minutes before serving.
